a: The bat riders' fire is a game object (spell 19629 summons 177764), so it shows as a trap rather than a spell target.
A dead high priest is resurrected after seven seconds unless the other two are dead too; all three must die inside one window.
Arlokk vanishes for half a minute and returns as a panther; while gone she leaves the mob list.
Gaze: the watched player must not move or act; a violation is a Decapitate. Player reports say damage-over-time ticks do not count.
Jin'do needs at least two players on his threat list or he resets.
Each Aspect is cast only while that high priest is alive; the panel cannot see which priests are dead.
Deep Breath is one of eight directional breath spells chosen from aMoveData; it has no timer so the panel shows no next window.
Version 1.18.1 adds a second dragon and Hatchers that are not in this script; they show only as mobs that carry a summoner.
Skeram splits at 75, 50 and 25 percent into himself and two images; the images have 10, 20 and then 50 percent of his health.
Earth Shock is cast only while his victim is out of melee reach; Arcane Explosion only while more players than allowed stand in melee reach.
The next Whirlwind timer starts when the 15 second Whirlwind ends; she goes berserk 10 minutes after the pull.
Entangle: three webs, each on a random player, inside a 45 second rotation; hatchlings spawn at the web the player was sent to.
Spawn of Fankriss: the first comes 20-30 s after the pull; each wave is 1-3 spawns 4-8 s apart, the next wave 18-37 s later; each spawn enrages after 15, 20 or 25 s.
Vek'lor takes no physical damage and Vek'nilash no spell damage; both teleport to swap places every 30-40 s.
The first three Eye Beams go to the puller, then to random targets; Dark Glare starts 45 s after the beam phase begins and lasts 38 s, and the next beam phase follows 1 s after it ends.
Phase 2: the first stomach grab comes 18 s minus the 3.25 s grab after he emerges, then every 10 s; killing both Flesh Tentacles in the stomach weakens him for 45 s.
Shadow Word: Pain and Mana Burn both go to a random attacker, not the tank.

Houndmaster Grebmar has no boss script: generic_spell_ai casts the three spells in his creature_template slots on a 10-20 s repeat with a first cast at the pull, skips a spell while its aura is up and retries a failed cast in 0.5 s, so the panel gets no script timer from them.

Bael'Gar has no boss script: EventAI runs four HP events that cast 13895 at 82, 62, 42 and 22 percent, each a cast-time spell at a random attacker that summons one Spawn of Bael'Gar where that player stands, plus his creature_spells list 90160, Magma Splash 13880 at his current victim every 10-14 s (first 8-12). The 13895 cast is not kickable (preventionType 0) and its timer columns are 0 because the events are HP thresholds.

The first Sunder is 5-10 s after the pull; the alarm fires as soon as he drops below 30 percent and again every 3 minutes while he stays below it, summoning eight Anvilrage Reservists and two Anvilrage Medics at the m_aAddspawnLocs points for 30 s.

The Anvilrage Medic is an elite add with creature_spells list 88940: Heal 15586 on the most injured ally every 4-6 s (first at the pull), Prayer of Healing 10961 on that ally every 6-9 s (first 7-11) and Mind Blast 10947 at the current victim every 2-3 s (first at the pull); all three are kickable casts.

Lightning Shield is re-applied whenever it is missing; its 15 s timer only limits the retry after the aura drops, and his ai_name EventAI never runs because the script_name npc_golem_lord_argelmach wins.
On aggro he walks to 846.801, 16.281, -53.640 and pulls the living Ragereaver Golems and Wrath Hammer Constructs within 80 yd onto his current victim.

Lord Incendius has no ai_name, script_name or EventAI row, but his creature_spells list 90170 runs under the default AggressorAI: Curse of the Elemental Lord 26977 on the raid every 20-28 s (first 1-5), Fiery Burst 13900 at his current victim every 9-16 s (first 6-11), Mighty Blow 14099 at a random attacker every 18-24 s (first 9-17) and Fire Storm 13899 at a random attacker every 11-14 s (first 12-16).

Fineous Darkvire has no boss script: EventAI casts Devotion Aura on himself after 1 s and every 4 minutes, Holy Strike at his current target every 6-8.5 s while it is within 5 yd (first at the pull), Holy Light on himself at 60 and again at 40 percent, and Seal of Reckoning at 20 percent; his creature_spells list 90560 casts Kick 11978 at his current victim every 11-15 s (first at the pull), which interrupts that player's cast. Holy Light is the only kickable cast.

Ambassador Flamelash has no boss script: his EventAI only switches the instance encounter, and the instance opens the seven dwarf runes and summons a Burning Spirit at each one every 15-30 s (5 s for the first), up to 30, which follow him. He casts 14744 on himself whenever a spirit's 13489 hits him.
War Stomp starts below 51 percent with a timer of 0, so the first one lands on the next update; Fiery Burst is a 10 yd area at his current victim.
Hand of Thaurissan is cast only while a player other than the top threat is alive; its first window is 5-7.5 s and a failed cast leaves the timer at 0 and retries every update.
Princess Moira Bronzebeard 8929 fights with him, heals him with 15586 whenever he is not at full health and turns friendly when he dies; she is an add row here, not a block of this table.
Ironfoe 15642 is defined in his script but never cast.
He evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 25 to 50; the enrage his comment asks about is not cast.
Hex adds 15 s to its own timer after a successful cast instead of resetting it; he evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 0 to 30.
Throw Axe stops after the second hit: the second applies the passive 16076 and the loop ends; the first throw is 10-30 s after the pull and repeats are 5-15 s.

Mother Smolderweb's creature_template ai_name is EventAI and its script_name is empty, so boss_mother_smolderweb.cpp never runs, but EventAI still runs her creature_spells list 105960 beside its own event: Crystallize 16104 hits a 120-degree cone in front of her every 10-17 s (first 7-15) for a magic-dispellable stun, Summon Spire Spiderling 16103 summons one Spire Spiderling 10375 every 15-20 s (first 5-15), and EventAI 1059603 casts Mother's Milk 16468 every 7-15 s while the current victim lacks it, picking a random attacker so the aura lands around her.
She evades when pulled by a pet or when her z is below 50; Hooked Net 15609 and the Healing Potion 15504 are declared in the script but never cast.
Gizrul the Slavener spawns when she dies through a direct SummonCreature at -167.58, -382.41, 64.401 and sets his home to -172.633, -324.253, 64.401; no spell is involved.

Gizrul the Slavener spawns when Halycon dies and fights with creature_spells list 102680: Fatal Bite 16495 at his current victim every 7-15 s (first 7-15) and Infected Bite 16128 every 10-20 s (first 15-20), a disease that also raises the physical damage its target takes; EventAI 1026801 casts Enrage 8269 below 20 percent and repeats it every 30 s while he stays below.
Below 51 percent he summons one Spirestone Warlord and one Smoldertooth Berserker once, at the two afLocations points; he evades when pulled by a pet or when his z leaves 72 to 100.

The Spirestone Warlord is summoned by Wyrmthalak below 51 percent; his creature_spells list 92160 casts Empower Will 16171 on himself every 20 s from the pull, dispelling polymorph, charm and knockout from nearby allies. His EventAI 921602 is named Frenzy at 30 percent but its only action is a text line.

The Smolderthorn Berserker is summoned by Wyrmthalak below 51 percent; his creature_spells list 92680 casts Strike 13446 at his current victim every 4-6 s (first 5-7) and Mortal Strike 17547 every 6-10 s (first 5), which cuts the victim's healing taken for 28 s and cannot be dispelled. His EventAI 926801 is named Frenzy at 30 percent but its only action is a text line.
